After classification and statistics, all archaeal sequences were assigned into 3 phyla, 6 classes, 8 orders, 10 families and 11 genera. The abundances of taxa were compared from level of phylum to level of genus and the variables that were significantly different between treatments are presented in Table 8. When examining all levels from phylum to genus, in comparison with CT, RYR had significantly lower abundances for Euryarchaeota (P = 0.002), Methanobacteria (P < 0.001), Methanobacteriales (P < 0.001), Methanobacteria- ceae (P < 0.001), Methanobrevibacter (P < 0.001) and unclassified Methanobacteriaceae (P = 0.007).
